freeze_before_outcomes: candidate intent counts by matching cell
candidate_specific_matching_budget.intent_budget: exact candidate intent count in each matching cell
candidate_specific_matching_budget.reason: candidate specificity enters only through the frozen matching budget and legal risk set; it may not create a second random-key namespace

decision_time_legal_pair_population.unit: one exact (completed decision minute t, source-neutral SPXW 0DTE contract) pair
all_required: the governed universal-grid minute is flat, action-eligible, and earlier than 15:30 America/New_York
the exact current 42-contract ladder and source-neutral identity are valid
the current bid and ask are finite, positive, executable, fresh, and internally consistent
the contract ask A_t is at least 100 cents
affordability, D48 intent, and D49 intent pass from A_t under the attempt's own causal policy ledger and active fee path
complete-ladder, warmup, context-freshness, no-prior-soft-close, and no-daily-stop masks pass
forbidden: label availability, target_valid, PnL, or oracle rank
decision_time_legal_pair_population.fee_paths: construct and replay fee_3 and fee_4 as separate causal trajectories

canonical_random_key.serialization: UTF-8 JSON object with sorted keys, compact separators (comma and colon), decimal integers, exact strings, and no NaN or Infinity
canonical_random_key.rank: interpret digest bytes 0 through 7 as one unsigned big-endian 64-bit integer
canonical_random_key.tie_break: the complete 32-byte digest, then the lexicographic exact-contract identity tuple

algorithm_in_order: freeze the label-blind candidate-specific matching budget
enumerate every decision-time legal pair under the causal t-intent law
compute the canonical random key independently for every registered attempt seed
within each matching cell sort by rank, complete digest, then exact-contract identity
take the first required count without replacement
if a cell has fewer legal pairs than its frozen budget, mark that attempt incomplete
never borrow from another cell and never redraw
schedule_construction.schedule_identity_artifact: ordered selected pair list plus complete eligible-population hash, matching-budget hash, attempt seed, and canonical generator-spec hash

selected_identity_fill_resolution.selection_at_t: uses only the decision-time legal pair population
selected_identity_fill_resolution.recheck_at_tplus1: inspect only the selected exact identity and require exact/fresh ask, 100-cent floor, affordability, D48, and D49 under the attempt's own ledger
selected_identity_fill_resolution.successful_recheck: fill one contract at the exact t+1 executable ask, then enter the common neutral lifecycle

serial_replay.policy_state: each attempt owns its cash, session-start equity, D48, D49, soft-close, daily-stop, pending, occupancy, and exit ledger
serial_replay.soft_close: current-ladder existence predicate under the active fee path; computed floor costs are 10300 cents for fee_3 and 10400 cents for fee_4
serial_replay.lifecycle: hold every successful fill to the exact 15:55 America/New_York bid-or-zero forced-flat boundary

aggregate.definition: nonselectable equal-weight mean of the eight attempt-specific session statistics

prohibited_overrides: using t+1 information to form the time-t eligible population
redraw, replacement, best-seed selection, or outcome matching
local consumer edits to this algorithm
